description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useProjectCostHistorySum' that fetches and manages the state of the total project cost, attempting to retrieve the sum from a specific API endpoint and falling back to a legacy endpoint if necessary. It formats the cost as USD currency and provides loading and error states.

methods.name: useProjectCostHistorySum
methods.description: A React hook that fetches the summed project cost, manages loading/error states, and formats the cost for display.
